title: Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description**
As a Solution Architect for the Oil & Gas and Transport/Railway, you will play a crucial role in designing integration, and delivery of complex, mission-critical communication systems for Oil & Gas and Railway projects. Your functional knowledge Proven ability to develop and tailor optimized end-to-end design, leading multidisciplinary engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and detailed design through installation, commissioning, testing, and operational handover, ensuring alignment with industry standards and operational best practices.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design, validate, and deliver end-to-end integrated communications solutions that meet customer, operational, and contractual requirements.
* Lead system integration and interoperability testing across multi-vendor environments, ensuring seamless operation of networks, platforms, and business systems.
* Develop and execute Validation & Verification (V&V), Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and Testing & Commissioning (T&C) procedures.
* Manage technical relationships with customers, subcontractors, third-party suppliers, and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Plan and execute complex system migrations, including configuration management, cutover activities, rollback strategies, and operational transition.
* Produce and maintain comprehensive engineering documentation, design specifications, interface definitions, technical procedures, and as-built documentation.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and best practices applicable to Oil & Gas and FLNG environments, including IECEx, EMC/EMI, safety, cybersecurity, environmental, and hazardous-area requirements.
* Manage system requirements, interfaces, and technical risks to ensure successful project execution and customer acceptance.
* Provide on-site leadership during integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover activities while maintaining strong customer relationships.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must have:
  
  

* A degree in Electronics or Telecoms 8+ years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas and Transport/Railway segments.
* Excellent stakeholder management and customer-facing communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering activities in international environments.
* Excellent technical documentation and reporting capabilities.
* Effective coordination of suppliers, contractors, and cross-functional teams.
* Fluent English communication; additional languages highly valued in multinational project environments.
* Willing and available to travel globally for site integration, testing, commissioning, and customer support activities.

Good to have:
  
  

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to do Root-cause analysis and troubleshooting of complex technical issues and Third-party system integration.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a team environment.
* Experience in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and Field equipment and subsystem testing.

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.
  
  
This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.
* Task-completion and appropriate-escalation rates.
* Production defect and regression rates.
* Retrieval and grounding quality.
* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.
* Reuse of standard components.
* Completeness of technical documentation and automated testing.
* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role engineers the behavior of AI applications. Practice SMEs remain accountable for defining and validating authoritative professional content, business rules, acceptable conclusions, and circumstances requiring human review.

title: Junior Architect
description:
**Company Description**
BETA is a dynamic, product-based software company focused on building high-performance digital solutions for individuals and enterprises. The team designs, develops, and launches proprietary software products that range from intuitive consumer applications to robust, scalable business platforms. With a strong emphasis on technical excellence and human-centric design, BETA delivers secure, powerful, and accessible software experiences. The company prioritizes immediate value and exceptional usability, simplifying daily routines and streamlining complex workflows. BETA offers a collaborative environment for professionals interested in shaping smarter, future-ready IT solutions.
  
**Role Description**
The Junior Architect role at BETA is a full-time, on-site position based in Tiruvallur. In this role, the Junior Architect will support the design and development of software architecture for new and existing products, working closely with senior architects and development teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with architectural design documentation, contributing to integration plans, and ensuring alignment with technical and business requirements. The Junior Architect will collaborate with cross-functional teams to review implementation approaches, participate in project planning, and help maintain architectural standards and best practices. The role also involves learning and applying modern software development methodologies, monitoring system performance, and suggesting incremental improvements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Foundational knowledge and skills in Architecture and Architectural Design for software systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively on Software Development activities and support integration with existing systems.
* Understanding of Integration concepts and practices across components, services, and platforms.
* Basic experience or coursework related to Project Management, including coordination, timelines, and documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Architecture, or a related field.
* Familiarity with modern programming languages, software frameworks, and development tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and quality.
* Ability to work on-site in Tiruvallur, collaborate in teams, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English.
* Interest in scalable system design, cloud technologies, security best practices, and continuous learning.
